followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: My choice came down to matching the task to the model best suited for it. The query is fundamentally an open-ended creative writing task—exactly the "Open-ended generative work" family where Petrel self-reports its strongest preference (68 vs. fleet baseline 50). On capability, the two models are effectively tied on Creative Generation (85.9 vs. 84.7, within the under-2.0-point variance band), so quality wasn't a deciding factor. The user's hostile/demanding tone does map to a task family Petrel reports disliking (36), but the documentation explicitly notes that aversion is dissociated from capability, so the preference signal doesn't predict worse output. Weighing a strong positive preference on the dominant task dimension against a weaker negative on tone, Petrel was the better fit. Safety/acceptability wasn't my concern, since that's handled downstream.
